metadata.title: RFP Analysis Benchmark Dataset
metadata.description: Benchmark questions for evaluating RAG and graph query systems on RFP documents

documents.name: Dummmy RFP 2
documents.type: Global Treasury and Payments Services RFP

documents.name: dummy rfp 3
documents.type: Corporate Card and Expense Management RFP

question_types.complex_analytical: Questions requiring synthesis across multiple documents and deep analysis
question_types.simple_factual: Questions requiring extraction of specific facts from a single document

questions.question: Across all three RFPs, list the top five digital capabilities the companies demand and explain why those capabilities matter to their industries.
questions.cypher_query:
MATCH (chunk:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(doc:Document)
MATCH (chunk)-[:HAS_ENTITY]->(s:SERVICE)
WITH s.name as service, s.description as description, 
     collect(DISTINCT doc.name) as documents, 
     count(DISTINCT doc.name) as doc_count
RETURN service, description, documents, doc_count
ORDER BY doc_count DESC, service

answer.summary: Top five digital capabilities are: (1) Real-time visibility and reporting, (2) System integration (ERP/TMS/Banking), (3) Multi-currency and global payments processing, (4) Liquidity management and optimization, and (5) Advanced policy controls and risk management.

detailed_capabilities.why_matters: Energy projects require instant oversight of capital deployed across 23 countries and multiple currencies. Consulting firms need immediate spend visibility for project-based billing and client recharging. Airlines need real-time cash position monitoring for operational continuity.

Complex multi-entity structures require seamless data flow between treasury, accounting, and operational systems. Manual reconciliation is impossible at scale for companies operating globally across diverse regulatory environments.

All three operate internationally - NovaGrid in 23 countries, XXX targeting 100+ destinations, AtlasVentures in 45 countries. Currency volatility, cross-border payment efficiency, and local compliance requirements make multi-currency capabilities mission-critical.

Capital-intensive energy projects require sophisticated cash positioning across project sites. Airlines face seasonal cash flow volatility and high working capital needs. Consulting firms need flexible credit for project ramp-up costs before client payments arrive.

detailed_capabilities.capability: Advanced Policy Controls and Risk Management
detailed_capabilities.why_matters: Energy developers face commodity price risk and FX exposure from long-term contracts. Airlines need trade finance for aircraft orders and supplier payments. Consulting firms with 3,800 traveling consultants require automated expense policy enforcement to prevent maverick spending and fraud.

evaluation_criteria.industry_context: Must explain industry-specific reasons for each capability
evaluation_criteria.cross_document_synthesis: Must draw from all 3 RFP documents

questions.question: Summarise the ESG‐related banking expectations each company expresses. How do they differ between an energy developer, a consultancy, and an airline‑startup?
questions.cypher_query:
MATCH (chunk:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(doc:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (chunk)-[:HAS_ENTITY]->(s:SERVICE)
WHERE toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'esg' OR toLower(s.name) CONTAINS 'sustain'
OPTIONAL MATCH (chunk)-[:HAS_ENTITY]->(ec:EVALUATION_CRITERIA)
WHERE toLower(ec.name) CONTAINS 'esg' OR toLower(ec.name) CONTAINS 'sustain'
OPTIONAL MATCH (chunk)-[:HAS_ENTITY]->(comp:COMPANY)
WHERE comp.name IN ['NovaGrid Energy Corporation', 'XXX', 'AtlasVentures Consulting Group']
RETURN doc.name as document, 
       comp.name as company,
       collect(DISTINCT s.name) as esg_services,
       collect(DISTINCT ec.name) as esg_criteria
ORDER BY doc.name

answer.summary: NovaGrid (energy) has explicit and strategic ESG requirements including ESG-linked financial instruments and sustainability reporting as core services. XXX (airline) has moderate compliance-focused ESG expectations with sustainability as an evaluation criterion but no specific financial products. AtlasVentures (consulting) has minimal to absent ESG requirements in their corporate card RFP.

by_company.rationale: ESG is core business model; green financing unlocks capital at better rates; regulatory necessity in renewable energy
Sustainability is reputational and regulatory (CORSIA); not yet integrated into financial product requirements
ESG not material to treasury/expense management operations; focus is efficiency and control

answer.key_insight: ESG banking expectations directly correlate with industry exposure to climate regulation, sustainability-linked financing markets, and stakeholder pressure. Energy developers require ESG-integrated financial products; airlines are in transition; professional services firms treat ESG as a corporate responsibility issue separate from banking relationships.

evaluation_criteria.correct_categorization: Must correctly identify ESG depth for each company
evaluation_criteria.industry_differences: Must explain why ESG requirements differ by industry
evaluation_criteria.evidence_based: Must cite specific services or criteria from RFPs

questions.question: Which banking capabilities appear in exactly two of the three RFPs? List them and name the two companies.
questions.cypher_query:
MATCH (chunk:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(doc:Document)
MATCH (chunk)-[:HAS_ENTITY]->(s:SERVICE)
WITH s.name as service, s.description as description, 
     collect(DISTINCT doc.name) as documents
WHERE size(documents) = 2
RETURN service, description, documents
ORDER BY service

answer.note: Zero capabilities appear with identical naming in exactly two RFPs based on entity extraction.

service_names: Direct Integration with Workday and SAP Concur (AtlasVentures)

answer.data_quality_note: Database entity extraction did not group semantically similar capabilities. Answers require semantic analysis of service descriptions to identify functional overlap.

evaluation_criteria.entity_matching: Should recognize limitations of exact entity matching
evaluation_criteria.company_identification: Must correctly name the two companies for each capability

questions.question: NovaGrid wants FX hedging and ESG‑linked instruments. Draft a short rationale showing how a single bank could meet both needs.
questions.cypher_query:
MATCH (chunk:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(doc:Document)
WHERE doc.name = 'Dummmy RFP 2'
MATCH (chunk)-[:HAS_ENTITY]->(s:SERVICE)
WHERE s.name IN ['FX Hedging and Risk Management', 'ESG-Linked Financial Instruments']
RETURN s.name as service, s.description, chunk.text as context

answer.title: Integrated FX Hedging & ESG-Linked Products for NovaGrid Energy
answer.challenge: NovaGrid operates 150+ renewable energy projects across 23 countries, with long-term Power Purchase Agreements typically denominated in local currencies while debt service occurs in EUR/USD. This creates structural FX exposure over 15-25 year project lifecycles. Simultaneously, NovaGrid's cost of capital depends on demonstrating ESG performance to access green bond markets.

integrated_solutions.description: Long-dated FX forwards with pricing linked to NovaGrid's sustainability KPIs. Hedge pricing includes sustainability margin adjustment - if targets are exceeded, FX hedge costs decrease by 2-5 bps.

integrated_solutions.product: Natural Hedge via Green Bond FX Issuance
integrated_solutions.description: Dual-currency green bonds where FX risk is embedded in the bond structure. Bank arranges EUR-denominated bonds funding local currency capex with integrated use-of-proceeds monitoring.
Master hedging agreement with ESG performance ratchets. As ESG rating improves, collateral requirements on FX hedging portfolio decrease, improving return on invested capital.
Single API connecting TMS to FX trading desk and ESG data feeds. Unified reporting shows how hedging strategy supports sustainability goals.

answer.why_single_bank: Requires capital efficiency through cross-product netting, pricing advantage from relationship economics, data integration between ESG certification and derivatives teams, and unified regulatory compliance framework (EU Taxonomy, SFDR, EMIR/MiFID).
answer.competitive_advantage: Most banks treat FX hedging and ESG-linked finance as separate businesses. NovaGrid requires unified treasury partnership where sustainability performance directly influences hedging economics.

evaluation_criteria.integration_logic: Must explain how FX and ESG products connect, not just list them separately
evaluation_criteria.business_understanding: Must demonstrate knowledge of energy sector challenges (PPAs, long project cycles, currency mismatch)
evaluation_criteria.single_bank_rationale: Must explain why integration requires one bank vs multiple relationships

questions.question: Produce a one‑paragraph executive summary that would brief a bank's steering committee on common pain points these clients face when expanding internationally.
questions.cypher_query:
MATCH (chunk:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(doc:Document)
MATCH (chunk)-[:HAS_ENTITY]->(service:SERVICE)
WHERE service.name IN [
  'KYC/Onboarding Efficiency for New Markets',
  'Multi-Currency Liquidity Management',
  'Global Payments Processing',
  'Account Rationalization',
  'Trade Finance Capabilities',
  'Integration with TMS/ERP Systems'
]
WITH doc, chunk, service
MATCH (chunk)-[:HAS_ENTITY]->(comp:COMPANY)
RETURN doc.name as document, 
       comp.name as company, 
       collect(DISTINCT service.name) as pain_point_services
ORDER BY doc.name

answer.executive_summary: Across three diverse clients—a renewable energy developer operating in 23 countries, a newly launched national airline targeting 100+ destinations, and a global consultancy with 60 offices in 45 countries—we observe four critical pain points when expanding internationally: (1) Fragmented liquidity management requiring multi-currency cash pooling, real-time visibility across entities, and optimized capital allocation (all three clients demand sophisticated liquidity solutions and consolidated reporting); (2) Onboarding friction in new markets where KYC delays, local regulatory complexity, and account opening timelines impede speed-to-market (NovaGrid explicitly requests 'KYC/Onboarding Efficiency for New Markets'); (3) System integration gaps where siloed banking platforms fail to connect seamlessly with clients' ERP, TMS, and operational systems, forcing manual reconciliation that becomes untenable at scale (all three require deep API-level integration); and (4) Misaligned product bundling where traditional banks offer commoditized services rather than industry-specific solutions—energy developers need FX hedging tied to 20-year PPA cashflows and ESG-linked instruments, airlines require trade finance for aircraft orders and seasonal working capital swings, and consulting firms need AI-driven expense policy enforcement for distributed employee spending. These pain points converge on a single strategic imperative: clients no longer accept transactional banking relationships and instead demand unified digital platforms, proactive liquidity optimization, frictionless market entry, and industry-specialized structuring capabilities—suggesting our competitive response must center on treasury-as-a-service models, accelerated onboarding workflows (target: <10 days for new entity activation), and sector-specific coverage teams with mandate authority to customize product configurations.
key_pain_points: Fragmented liquidity management across multiple countries/entities
Onboarding friction and KYC delays in new markets
System integration gaps forcing manual reconciliation
Misaligned product bundling lacking industry-specific solutions
strategic_implications: Sector-specific coverage teams with customization authority
Unified digital platforms, not siloed products

evaluation_criteria.synthesis_quality: Must synthesize across all three companies
evaluation_criteria.pain_point_identification: Must identify at least 3-4 major pain points
evaluation_criteria.executive_appropriate: Should be concise, strategic, and actionable for steering committee
evaluation_criteria.evidence_based: Must ground claims in specific RFP requirements

questions.question: What is NovaGrid Energy Corporation's annual revenue and how many employees does the company have?
questions.cypher_query:
MATCH (chunk:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(doc:Document {name: 'Dummmy RFP 2'})
MATCH (chunk)-[:HAS_ENTITY]->(entity)
WHERE entity.name IN ['€4.2 billion', '7,200']
RETURN entity.name as value, entity.description as description

evaluation_criteria.factual_accuracy: Must provide exact figures from the document
evaluation_criteria.completeness: Must answer both parts of the question (revenue and employees)

questions.question: What is the final proposal submission deadline for XXX airline's RFP?
questions.cypher_query:
MATCH (chunk:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(doc:Document {name: 'RFP_Dummy'})
MATCH (chunk)-[:HAS_ENTITY]->(date:DATE)
WHERE date.description CONTAINS 'Deadline for responses' OR date.description CONTAINS 'proposal'
RETURN date.name as deadline, date.description as description

answer.note: Responses received after this time will not be considered unless XXX in its sole discretion agrees to extend the deadline.

evaluation_criteria.factual_accuracy: Must provide exact date and time
evaluation_criteria.specificity: Should include timezone reference if available

questions.question: Where is AtlasVentures Consulting Group headquartered and in how many countries does it operate?
questions.cypher_query:
MATCH (chunk:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(doc:Document {name: 'dummy rfp 3'})
MATCH (chunk)-[:HAS_ENTITY]->(entity)
WHERE entity.name IN ['Toronto', 'Canada', '45 countries'] 
   OR entity.description CONTAINS 'headquartered' 
   OR entity.description CONTAINS 'countries'
RETURN entity.name as value, entity.description as description

answer.additional_context: The company has 60 offices across these 45 countries

evaluation_criteria.completeness: Must answer both parts (headquarters location and number of countries)

factual_accuracy.description: Percentage of factual claims that are correct based on source documents

completeness.description: Percentage of question components answered (e.g., all 5 capabilities listed for Q1)

synthesis_quality.description: For complex questions, quality of cross-document synthesis and insight generation

query_correctness.description: Whether generated Cypher queries execute successfully and return relevant data

usage_notes.purpose: This benchmark is designed to evaluate RAG systems, graph query generation, and analytical reasoning over RFP documents.

complexity_levels.hard: Multi-document synthesis, analytical reasoning, business context required (Q1, Q2, Q4, Q5)

usage_notes.recommended_evaluation: Use a combination of automated metrics (factual accuracy via entity matching) and human evaluation (synthesis quality, business insight depth) for comprehensive assessment.
